scripts.preinstall:
node -e "if (!/yarn/.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'')) { console.error('
✖ This repo uses yarn (yarn.lock is the real lockfile) — run: yarn install

  Note: this only catches a bare, no-argument npm install. Adding a single package (npm install some-pkg) does NOT run this script at all — confirmed empirically against husridge-server, same npm behavior applies here. The pre-commit hook and prebuild script are what actually catch that case.
'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.prebuild: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('package-lock.json')) { console.error('\n\u2716 package-lock.json is committed \u2014 this repo uses yarn.lock only. Run: git rm package-lock.json && yarn install, then commit the resynced yarn.lock.\n'); process.exit(1); }"
